claim: under lagged confounding, temporal backdoor identification returns Z at offset -1 (not empty) with method temporal.backdoor.unfolded, and the estimator recovers the structural pulse; omitting Z leaves that method with an empty adjustment set and the confounded association

identification.note: Empty Z with this method on this graph is the schedule-ID relabel bug: general ID emits Z=[], then a temporal.backdoor.unfolded label, then unadjusted OLS. Pulse and single-step Sustained must share this nonempty lagged Z.

unadjusted.note: Same estimator on the subgraph that omits Z. Empty Z is valid for that graph; slope 4.5 is the confounded association, not the interventional response.

surface.note: Cells are (dose=0,h=1), (dose=0,h=2), (dose=1,h=1), (dose=1,h=2). Horizon 1 stays the structural pulse [1, 3]. Horizon 2 has no graph backdoor (I(2)={}); the cells are the unadjusted lag-2 association in this periodic sample, not E[Y]=1. Reusing I(2)={} at h=1 yields the confounded [1, 5.5] at the short cells.

estimator_contract.estimator: temporal response linear g-computation over a lag-aligned OLS design that includes the temporal-backdoor adjustment set identified for that horizon
estimator_contract.claim: identification is Z@-1 with method temporal.backdoor.unfolded at horizon 1; with that Z, finite-sample OLS recovers the structural intercept and pulse coefficient; PulseEffect / single-step SustainedEffect recover the two-point contrast 2. Empty Z on this graph at horizon 1 is not a valid identification. Horizons [1, 2] identify I(1)={Z@-1} and I(2)={} separately; reusing I(2) at horizon 1 recovers the confounded association.
estimator_contract.not_claimed: no outcome noise beyond the treatment equation A=Z+U, no Python offset-level adjustment view on the scalar IdentificationView.adjustment_set (Python pins names plus horizon_adjustment_sets; Rust pins (variable, offset) on CausalResponse.horizon_identification)

generation.outcome_sequence: y_i = 1 + 2*t_(i-1) + 5*z_(i-1), with pre-sample values equal to 0
generation.note: n=241 makes the lag-aligned Z window an exact number of periods, so E[Z]=0 and E[Y|do(A=d)] = 1+2d exactly. Unadjusted OLS of Y on A has slope 4.5. An unconfounded DGP would not distinguish empty-Z identification from the correct backdoor set.
